research_question: Does the exact first-ten-second Binance futures order imbalance at quarter-hour boundaries, routed by either recent boundary-flow persistence or a separately observed public trend/volume state and confirmed by a later five-minute bar, produce cost-positive four-to-eight-hour directional opportunities?

external_mechanism.source: Kim and Hansen (2026), The Quarter-Hour Effect
reused: first ten seconds of every 15-minute boundary
public price-volume state as a separate explanatory component
adapted: Binance futures one-second klines reconstruct ten-second signed quote-volume imbalance
a wholly subsequent five-minute bar confirms a new tradable leg
one global position across BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP
twenty basis points reserved for round-trip execution, funding and impact

data.event_source: Binance Vision USD-M daily one-second klines
data.outcome_source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly/daily one-minute klines
data.visibility: event imbalance uses only seconds 0-9; public state ends before the boundary; confirmation is a separate completed five-minute interval; entry is after confirmation

routes.QH_BOUNDARY_FLOW_PERSISTENCE_4H: current extreme ten-second imbalance agrees with at least two-thirds of the prior twelve quarter-hour imbalances and a separate subsequent five-minute confirmation
routes.QH_PUBLIC_STATE_DELIVERY_8H: current extreme ten-second imbalance agrees with at least three of four pre-boundary return horizons, elevated recent volume and a separate subsequent five-minute confirmation

evaluation.same_event_arbitration: PUBLIC_STATE_DELIVERY first, then larger normalized imbalance-times-state-quality, then symbol
evaluation.overlap_policy: no new selected event while the fixed route horizon is active

advance_gate.final_integrated_system_frequency_requir: at least one independent completed trade per evaluation calendar day after global arbitration

decision_contract.advance: Only a fixed route passing development, year-long stability, July confirmation and latest pulse advances to a frozen NautilusTrader implementation.
decision_contract.reject: Do not tune ten-second imbalance, persistence, public-state or confirmation thresholds after seeing the declared results.
